title: Continuous binary implementation congruence and sharp finite welfare frontier
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: A general two-alternative implementation characterization on own-type domains containing an open ball: affine private and social valuation differences, nonzero social linear form, one active welfare cut, and a fixed independent opposing probability law force nonnegative coefficient alignment. Arbitrary measurable efficient lotteries have integrable Bayesian incentive compatible transfers exactly under alignment, with explicit ex-post truthful-opponent transfers and a measurable efficient allocation witness. review.reason: Characterizes binary implementation congruence and welfare frontiers for two-alternative mechanisms.
